what: Adoro te devote as Britt 1922 prints it (no. 79), transcribed from the page images to collate the corpus's received Latin against a named public-domain printing. Collation only: this file does NOT supply the corpus text. build_hymn_corpus.py compares it word by word with the la.1 witnesses of hymns:adoro-te and writes the result into manifest.sources['roman-missal-received']; every difference goes to Adam on docs/review/2026-09-26-adoro-collation.md (README-hymn-jsonl.md s.10).

edition.title: The Hymns of the Breviary and Missal
edition.heading: Adoro te devote, latens Deitas

scan.page_images: https://archive.org/download/hymnsofbreviarym00britrich/page/n<scan page>.jpg; printed page p is scan page n(p+9)

pages_read.holds: st. 5-7 (Latin and verse English); Britt's note and prose begin

transcription.method: Read from the page images at full resolution (2001x3087), the Latin column cropped and read line by line; the OCR text layer was not used. Same conventions as britt-1922-corpus-christi.json: ligatures, consonantal j, capitals and punctuation exactly as printed; the display capital (ADORO) in title case; a line the narrow column turned over is rejoined, and each is listed in `rejoined`.
transcription.not_transcribed: Britt's verse English (Justice John O'Hagan's translation, per Britt's note on p. 191) and his literal prose (pp. 191-192): both PD, neither needed to collate the Latin.

la: Quæ sub his figuris vere latitas:
Tibi se cor meum totum subjicit,
Visus, tactus, gustus in te fallitur,
At hic latet simul et humanitas:
Fac me tibi semper magis credere,
In te spem habere, te diligere.
Præsta meæ menti de te vivere,
Et te illi semper dulce sapere.
Totum mundum quit ab omni scelere.
Oro fiat illud, quod tam sitio:
